price_observations.oi_scope: 7 contracts; page displays five exchange rows

cross_provider_quality.interpretation: These values are not a synchronized common universe. TradRadar reports seven exchanges; Kodexius reports seven contracts; Seandra reports Binance USDT perpetual only. Provider and contract coverage differ. Do not average, sum, or infer a market-wide OI change.
cross_provider_quality.prior_context: Earlier same-day snapshots from Liqwall and CoinGecko were materially different again; retain each provider series independently until contract coverage and definitions are reconciled.
cross_provider_quality.funding: Reported funding is positive across these observations, but contract coverage and funding-period conventions must remain attached to each value.
cross_provider_quality.positioning: Long-account ratios are provider-specific account or trader metrics, not notional exposure or proof of a crowded aggregate position.

etf.coverage: Six US spot funds plus BITW in holdings total; GXRP excluded from flow calculation while a historical scrape gap is being reconciled.

exchange_wallets.caveat: Includes cold storage and unclassified attributed wallets; not tradable float. Same-wallet deltas do not prove customer withdrawals or sales.
